items.title: Connect over 1,500 apps
items.body: A new Connections page you can search, with one click to connect, plus a Connect card right in the chat. Anything that sends or changes something asks first.

items.title: A skills library
items.body: About 180 ready-made skills to install, kept up to date, with one-click updates.

items.title: Simpler Settings
items.body: Six pages instead of thirteen, now inside the main window.

items.title: Memory works by itself
items.body: AntiChat remembers lasting things you tell it and shows what it saved, with Undo.

items.title: Better answers
items.body: Long replies are no longer cut short, follow-ups remember what was just found, and Evil Mode has a calmer look and sets itself up reliably.
